description: Canonical ObservationType namespace. Observation.ObservationType (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Observations/Observation.cs) is a free-form string, not an enum, by design (docs/refactor/modularity/observation-and-correlation-model.md § 7 keeps it open until enough producers exist to justify closing it) — this registry is the checked-in record of every type actually emitted today, so a typo or a silent rename is a diffable, reviewable event instead of an invisible string drift. Cross-checked against real analyzer output by tests/DumpDetective.Tests/Unit/Architecture/SdkRegistryConformanceTests.cs. Purity rules for every entry's measures (raw only, never a severity/weighted composite) are in Observation.cs's own remarks and observation-and-correlation-model.md § 2a.

contention.episode.note: Named 'contention.episode', not the earlier design table's 'contention.hotspot' — 'hotspot' is a ranking/severity claim, which observation purity rules push to a synthesis rule (Phase 5, not yet built) instead. See the analyzer's own remarks.

cpu.sample-attribution.note: Named 'cpu.sample-attribution', not 'cpu.hotspot', same reasoning as contention.episode above. Leaf-frame-only (exclusive samples), not an inclusive call-tree breakdown — see the analyzer's own remarks.
